description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Lee Sin''' smashes the ground beneath him, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, marking them for 4 seconds and, if they are not [[File:Twilight Shroud old2.png|20px|link=Stealth#Invisibility|An icon representing the keyword Invisibility]] [[:Stealth#Invisibility|invisible]] when struck, [[File:True Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight#True_sight|An icon representing the keyword True sight]] [[:Sight#True_sight|revealing]] them for the same duration.
description.text: Active: Lee Sin smashes the ground beneath him, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, marking them for 4 seconds and, if they are not invisible when struck, revealing them for the same duration.

description2.raw: If ''Tempest'' hits an enemy, '''Lee Sin''' can cast ''[[File:Lee Sin Cripple.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Cripple|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Cripple]] [[Lee Sin#Cripple|Cripple]]'' within the next 3 seconds after a 0.1-second delay.
description2.text: If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast Cripple within the next 3 seconds after a 0.1-second delay.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
35 / 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 (+ 90% AD)

notes.raw: * ''Tempest's'' sight reveal only reveals the affected targets, but visually also lights up the Fog of War in a 400 radius. * ''Tempest's'' sight reveal is not removed when ''Lee Sin'' casts ''Cripple'' (unlike [[File:Lee Sin Sonic Wave.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Sonic Wave|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Sonic Wave]] [[Lee Sin#Sonic Wave|Sonic Wave's]]). * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
Tempest's sight reveal only reveals the affected targets, but visually also lights up the Fog of War in a 400 radius.
Tempest's sight reveal is not removed when Lee Sin casts Cripple (unlike Sonic Wave's).
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.

description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Lee Sin''' [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] nearby enemies marked by ''[[File:Lee Sin Tempest.png|20xpx|border|link=Lee Sin#Tempest|An icon for Lee Sin's ability Tempest]] [[Lee Sin#Tempest|Tempest]]'', decaying in strength over 4 seconds.
description.text: Active: Lee Sin slows nearby enemies marked by Tempest, decaying in strength over 4 seconds.

description2.raw: ''A nearby marked enemy is required to cast this ability.''
description2.text: A nearby marked enemy is required to cast this ability.
